verdict.rationale: The evidence shows single-item API operations (creating one contractor contract, submitting one time-off request) and a list/read tool, but no documented bulk or batch operation that acts on many items at once. The payroll marketing copy about paying workers across 150+ countries does not describe a bulk-operation API or tool, and listing contracts is a read, not a bulk action.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
